findings.title: Diffusion inherits concrete gravity source owners through a broad Hydro helper
findings.baseline: DiffFlux -> TimeIntegratorHelper existed in main; abstract gravity dependency existed. Current helper imports concrete Native source stages and domain solver declarations. Do not reverse the preceding geometry/gravity ownership repair.
findings.impact: Unrelated diffusion includes/rebuilds can depend on concrete gravity headers. No compile cost, runtime regression or gravity activation was measured in this audit.
findings.smallest_later_action: Keep one shared divergence implementation in an existing numerical owner; narrow its include boundary or move only Hydro-source composition to its existing Hydro binding. Preserve arithmetic order, actual source receipts and O7. No universal source/plugin framework.

findings.title: FluidState attaches concrete ephemeral boundary-control and observer storage
findings.baseline: Both shared_ptr attachments were absent in main, introduced by d45ea29562ca8d637454cb2fb9504e10bccdc299 for typed user boundaries, distinct from later RZ angular state leaves.
findings.impact: Universal fluid storage carries concrete boundary header dependencies and stage/regrid/rollback lifetime requirements. Actual per-block sharing is functional and must be retained. No gravity fields or incorrect observer numerics were found.
findings.smallest_later_action: First evaluate forward declarations plus direct memory include for header narrowing. If pure evolved-state ownership is required, separately evaluate existing block/runtime-owned per-block attachments and explicit borrowed views; preserve three-slot aliasing, rollback/regrid and CPU/CUDA mapping. Forward declarations alone do not remove lifecycle coupling. Never move per-block storage blindly to per-run RunState or add opaque type erasure merely for style.

findings.title: GlobalDefs resolved values borrow preview type and indirectly include the whole parser
findings.baseline: GlobalDefs -> PreviewMetadata was already present. PreviewMetadata -> ConfigParser is new; current local closure adds ParameterKeys, StandardParameterEntries.inc, MaterialValue and ConfigParser but no concrete physics owner.
findings.impact: Configuration value/trace/error and parser implementation responsibilities share a broad public header path. No GUI dependency or scientific fallback inferred.
findings.smallest_later_action: If narrowed, give scalar values/errors/strict conversion one existing core/config owner shared by loader and inspector. Retain all O7 presence/type/source/preparation checks and exact diagnostics; do not restore old custom maps or defaults.

findings.title: GridMetrics imports reconstruction moments solely for shared Gauss-4 data
findings.baseline: New relative to main. Current header also carries cubic reconstruction helpers; the actual Gauss nodes/weights must remain shared.
findings.impact: Geometry sees reconstruction implementation details; no concrete gravity/EOS owner or algorithm change shown.
findings.smallest_later_action: Consider a common low-level mathematical owner only when existing ownership or measured dependency benefit justifies it. Keep one set of exact nodes/weights; do not duplicate constants or create a new file merely for visual purity.

findings.title: IHydroSolver imports RuntimeParams despite requiring numeric configuration declarations
findings.baseline: Same RuntimeParams include already present in main. Not newly introduced by RZ or the latest source repair.
findings.impact: An interface intended as a compilation boundary inherits concrete configuration-loader dependencies. No behavioral failure shown.
findings.smallest_later_action: Use existing configuration declarations/direct minimal includes or forward declarations where valid, retaining the same interface and strict loader behavior.
